parameters.query:
-- Subject words not matched to YSO yet: the words a source sent with an
-- article, such as a thesis's own terms, and the words signal detection gave
-- articles. Each word is asked about once and tag_labels keeps the answer, a
-- miss as well. The language of an article the word came with is tried first.
WITH words AS (
    SELECT s.label, min(coalesce(i.source_language, 'fi')) AS lang
      FROM item_subjects s
      JOIN items i ON i.id = s.item_id
     GROUP BY s.label
    UNION ALL
    SELECT lower(btrim(g.topic)), 'fi'
      FROM signals g
     WHERE g.status <> 'dismissed'
)
SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('label', w.label, 'lang', w.lang)), '[]'::jsonb) AS words
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (label) label, lang
          FROM words
         WHERE label <> ''
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tag_labels l WHERE l.label = words.label)
         ORDER BY label, lang
         LIMIT 200) w;

-- New YSO terms, then each word's answer, a miss included. A term that two
-- words share, such as learning and oppiminen, is one tag.
WITH answers AS (
    SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(label text, uri text, name text)
),
new_tags AS (
    INSERT INTO tags (uri, label)
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (uri) uri, name
      FROM answers
     WHERE uri IS NOT NULL AND name IS NOT NULL
    ON CONFLICT (uri) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING id, uri
),
saved AS (
    INSERT INTO tag_labels (label, tag_id)
    SELECT a.label, coalesce(n.id, t.id)
      FROM answers a
      LEFT JOIN new_tags n ON n.uri = a.uri
      LEFT JOIN tags t     ON t.uri = a.uri
    ON CONFLICT (label) DO UPDATE
       SET tag_id = EXCLUDED.tag_id, checked_at = now()
    RETURNING tag_id
)
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE tag_id IS NOT NULL) AS matched,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE tag_id IS NULL)     AS not_in_yso,
       $2::text                                   AS error
  FROM saved;

-- The matched words become tags on their articles. A tag an editor took off
-- stays off: its row is still there, so nothing new is inserted for it. Only
-- recent articles, and older ones whose word was matched just now, are looked
-- at, so the run stays short as the archive grows.
WITH subjects AS (
    INSERT INTO item_tags (item_id, tag_id, origin, position)
    SELECT s.item_id, l.tag_id, 'source', min(s.position)
      FROM item_subjects s
      JOIN tag_labels l ON l.label = s.label AND l.tag_id IS NOT NULL
      JOIN items i      ON i.id = s.item_id
     WHERE i.created_at > now() - interval '60 days'
        OR l.checked_at > now() - interval '1 day'
     GROUP BY s.item_id, l.tag_id
    ON CONFLICT (item_id, tag_id) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING 1
),
from_signals AS (
    INSERT INTO item_tags (item_id, tag_id, origin)
    SELECT DISTINCT si.item_id, l.tag_id, 'signal'
      FROM signal_items si
      JOIN signals g    ON g.id = si.signal_id AND g.status <> 'dismissed'
      JOIN tag_labels l ON l.label = lower(btrim(g.topic)) AND l.tag_id IS NOT NULL
    ON CONFLICT (item_id, tag_id) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING 1
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM subjects)     AS from_subjects,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM from_signals) AS from_signals;

-- Summaries Finto AI has not read yet, newest first, 40 a run, so a backlog
-- clears over a few runs. An article whose source sent its own subject words,
-- a thesis for example, already has tags and is left out. One that got an
-- error from the service is tried again after an hour.
SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', x.id, 'text', x.text)
                          ORDER BY x.created_at DESC), '[]'::jsonb) AS articles,
       (SELECT value FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'tagging_min_score')   AS min_score
  FROM (SELECT i.id, i.created_at,
               -- A Finnish title helps; an English one would only confuse a
               -- Finnish indexer, and the summary is always Finnish.
               CASE WHEN coalesce(i.source_language, s.language) = 'fi'
                    THEN i.title || '. ' ELSE '' END || sm.text AS text
          FROM items i
          JOIN summaries sm   ON sm.item_id = i.id AND sm.language = 'fi'
          LEFT JOIN sources s ON s.id = i.source_id
          LEFT JOIN item_tagging t ON t.item_id = i.id
         WHERE i.status = 'summarised'
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM item_subjects x WHERE x.item_id = i.id)
           AND (t.item_id IS NULL
                OR (t.error IS NOT NULL AND t.checked_at < now() - interval '1 hour'))
         ORDER BY i.created_at DESC
         LIMIT 40) x;

-- The suggestions become tags, and each summary is marked as read, with how
-- many terms were kept or the error the service gave.
WITH done AS (
    SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(id bigint, terms jsonb, error text)
),
terms AS (
    SELECT d.id, t.uri, t.label, t.score, t.rank
      FROM done d
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_recordset(coalesce(d.terms, '[]'::jsonb))
           AS t(uri text, label text, score numeric, rank int)
),
new_tags AS (
    INSERT INTO tags (uri, label)
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (uri) uri, label FROM terms
    ON CONFLICT (uri) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING id, uri
),
tagged AS (
    INSERT INTO item_tags (item_id, tag_id, origin, score, position)
    SELECT x.id, coalesce(n.id, g.id), 'finto', round(x.score, 4), x.rank
      FROM terms x
      LEFT JOIN new_tags n ON n.uri = x.uri
      LEFT JOIN tags g     ON g.uri = x.uri
    ON CONFLICT (item_id, tag_id) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING item_id
),
checked AS (
    INSERT INTO item_tagging (item_id, checked_at, suggested, error)
    SELECT d.id, now(), jsonb_array_length(coalesce(d.terms, '[]'::jsonb)), d.error
      FROM done d
    ON CONFLICT (item_id) DO UPDATE
       SET checked_at = now(), suggested = EXCLUDED.suggested, error = EXCLUDED.error
    RETURNING item_id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM checked) AS summaries,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM tagged)  AS tags,
       $2::text                       AS error;
